clue.text: Peaceful country's extinction

parts.note: peaceful means quiet
US is the United States, a country

explanation.surface: A tranquil nation's dying out.
explanation.definitionFit: A quietus is a release from life, a death or final ending, so it fits extinction.

clue.text: Drink reduced by one pound — that's one pound!

indicators.note: a drink reduced by something has those letters taken away from the word

parts.note: a liquid is something you drink
L is the abbreviation for pound (libra)
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A drink costs a pound less, and the barman exclaims at the price.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking L and I out of LIQUID leaves the slang word for a pound sterling.
explanation.definitionFit: Quid is everyday British slang for a pound sterling, so the exclamation defines it.

clue.text: Vamp one's out to pick up

indicators.note: out says the letters for one's are dropped from the longer word

parts.note: to vamp in music is to improvise an accompaniment
one's is I (one) plus S

explanation.surface: Someone's flirting is being toned down, to get better.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing I and S from IMPROVISE leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up, as trade or health does, is to get better, the same as improving.

clue.text: Card, a jack, starts off one trick

parts.note: a jack (jack tar) is a sailor, a tar

indicators.note: the starts of the words one and trick give their first letters

explanation.surface: A card trick in which a jack begins the routine.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack is old slang for a sailor, as is TAR; the first letters of 'one trick' add O and T.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarot is one of the picture cards in a fortune-telling pack.

clue.text: Clean up — namely, exact payment for misdeed

parts.note: SC (scilicet) is the abbreviation meaning namely
to avenge is to exact retribution for a wrong

explanation.surface: Clean up the mess, that is, make someone pay for their crime.
explanation.definitionFit: To scavenge is to clean up refuse, as street scavengers once did.

clue.text: How stripper ends up in shortened version of musical entertainment

indicators.note: in places the stripper's state inside the shortened show's name
a shortened version loses its last letter

parts.note: Cats is a famous musical
a stripper ends up bare, naked

explanation.surface: A stripper's act appears in a cut-down version of a stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Musical entertainment' looks like the definition, but musical is CATS, cut to CAT, holding BARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Cabaret is entertainment, often songs and dancing, put on in a club or restaurant.

clue.text: Drop off and start to tuck into savoury — don't finish it

indicators.note: into puts the first letter of tuck inside the shortened savoury
not finishing the savoury drops its last letter

parts.note: a canape is a small savoury

indicators.note: the start of tuck is its first letter

explanation.surface: Doze off and begin eating a snack, leaving it half done.
explanation.definitionFit: To catnap is to doze briefly, to drop off for a moment.

clue.text: Bishop, beset by ill-feeling, gets hit in some fundamentalist states

indicators.note: beset by means the bishop is surrounded by the word for ill-feeling

parts.note: bile is bitterness, ill-feeling
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
to belt is to hit

explanation.surface: A bishop surrounded by hostility gets beaten up in conservative religious territory.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible Belt is the group of US southern states where fundamentalist Protestantism is strong.

clue.text: A lot of people, coming about, almost turn into the wind and anchor

indicators.note: coming about is a sailing term for turning, so the combined letters are turned back to front
almost removes the last letter

parts.note: to luff is to turn a boat's head into the wind
to moor is to anchor

explanation.surface: A crowd of sailors tacking, luffing up and dropping anchor.
explanation.walkthrough: LUF (LUFF less F) plus MOOR, read backwards because of 'coming about', gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A roomful is as many people as a room holds, a lot of people.

clue.text: Bear up, surrounded by Bangladeshi coins on top of Kidderminster carpet

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the first group above what follows
surrounded by puts the reversed bear inside the coins

parts.note: the taka is the currency unit of Bangladesh

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: to tote is to bear, carry

indicators.note: the top of Kidderminster is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Kidderminster carpet bought with Bangladeshi money is carried upstairs.
explanation.walkthrough: Kidderminster is an English town famous for carpets, so 'carpet' looks like a noun, but it is a verb meaning to scold.
explanation.definitionFit: To carpet someone is to reprimand them, as is to take them to task.

clue.text: Convert tramp into major

indicators.note: convert means change the form of these letters

explanation.surface: Change a vagrant into a senior army officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Major as an adjective means important, significant.

clue.text: Black bird's stomach

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
a rook is a black bird of the crow family

explanation.surface: A dark bird's belly.
explanation.definitionFit: To stomach something is to tolerate it, to brook it.

clue.text: Apparently you can find a clock's numbers here

definitions.text: you can find a clock's numbers here
definitions.meaning: a clock's numbers are on its dial, its face

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means at first sight, and literally the numbers sit on a clock's face.

clue.text: Collapse of card-castle — a child's construction

indicators.note: a collapse leaves the card house's letters tumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A house of cards falls down: something a child built.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat's cradle is a pattern of string a child builds between the fingers in a game.

clue.text: Survivor of fire retired, say, in denial

parts.note: retired for the night means abed

indicators.note: in puts the abbreviation for say inside the denial

parts.note: no is a denial
EG (for example) means say

explanation.surface: A fire survivor has gone to bed, perhaps, and refuses to admit anything.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Book of Daniel, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego survived the fiery furnace.
explanation.definitionFit: Abednego is one of the three men in Daniel who came out of the furnace unharmed.

clue.text: Don't worry little boy about pests

indicators.note: about means the boy's name goes round the pests

parts.note: Ned is a short form of Edward, a little boy's name
vermin are pests

explanation.surface: Telling a young lad not to fret about the rats.
explanation.definitionFit: Never mind is an idiom meaning don't worry about it.

clue.text: Ball the French run around

indicators.note: around puts the word for run round the French article

parts.note: to pelt is to run fast
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A French ball game played at a run.
explanation.definitionFit: A pellet is a small ball, as of shot or paper.

clue.text: A single man hurt after start of brawl -—- gosh!

indicators.note: after says the hurt comes after that letter
the start of brawl is its first letter

parts.note: to ache is to hurt
lor is an exclamation like gosh

explanation.surface: An unmarried man injured in a fight exclaims in surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: LOR, a dated British exclamation from 'Lord', means gosh.
explanation.definitionFit: A bachelor is an unmarried man.

clue.text: Try a way to split up

parts.note: ST (street) is a way
to rive is to split apart

explanation.surface: Attempt to divide a route.
explanation.definitionFit: To strive is to try hard.

clue.text: Pound almost covers fish brought up and preserved again

indicators.note: brought up in a down clue says the whole assembly is read upwards, backwards
covers means the shortened poet surrounds the fish
almost drops the last letter

parts.note: Ezra Pound was the American poet
the orfe is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A pound weight of fish hauled up and put back in the freezer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pound' is the poet Ezra Pound: EZR (almost) around ORFE makes EZORFER, read upwards for 'brought up'.
explanation.definitionFit: Refrozen food has been frozen once more, preserved again by freezing.

clue.text: Keep unfinished and unopened jars together — let chance decide

indicators.note: unfinished drops the last letter of the keep

parts.note: a keep is the stronghold of a castle

indicators.note: unopened takes away the first letter

parts.note: pots are jars

explanation.surface: Store the half-done and sealed jars together, leaving it to luck.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast lots is to draw or throw lots so that chance makes a decision.

clue.text: Thrust forward, storming redoubt

indicators.note: storming suggests violent upheaval, so the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: Pushing ahead while attacking a fortification.
explanation.definitionFit: To obtrude is to thrust forward or push oneself in.

clue.text: Chameleon, perhaps, initially like chamois

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of like

parts.note: the izard is the Pyrenean chamois

explanation.surface: A chameleon at first resembling a mountain goat.
explanation.walkthrough: The izard is the chamois of the Pyrenees, a goat-antelope.
explanation.definitionFit: A chameleon is an example of a lizard, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Clean-up of river — but fishermen need treatment later

indicators.note: later says the rearranged letters come after the river
needing treatment says these letters must be worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Cleaning up a river, though anglers will need medical care afterwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'need treatment' rearranges BUT FISHERMEN into EFURBISHMENT, placed after R.
explanation.definitionFit: A refurbishment is a renovation, a thorough clean-up.

clue.text: Expect to lose opening pair in order

indicators.note: losing the opening pair removes the first two letters

parts.note: to predict is to expect

explanation.surface: Anticipate dropping the first two in the sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: An edict is an official order or decree.

clue.text: Suitable sporting occasion

definitions.meaning: an old word for suitable or fitting
a gathering for a hunt or athletics

explanation.definitionFit: Meet means fitting in old usage, and is also a sporting gathering.

clue.text: Garment primarily dressing Hindus or their ilk

indicators.note: primarily takes the first letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A garment chiefly worn by Hindus and people like them.
explanation.definitionFit: A dhoti is a loincloth worn by Hindu men in India.

clue.text: It's true — ale is, surprisingly, free

indicators.note: surprisingly signals that the letters turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: It's a fact: the beer is complimentary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surprisingly' rearranges TRUE ALE IS; 'It's' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: At leisure means free, not occupied.

clue.text: Finished up with me inside being subjected to correction

definitions.note: read as a participle phrase: having undergone correction

indicators.note: inside puts the word me within the word for finished

parts.note: ended means finished up

explanation.surface: It all ended with me caught up in being corrected.
explanation.definitionFit: Emended text has been corrected by editing.

clue.text: Go back a short distance into desert, abandoning motorway

indicators.note: into places the shortened distance inside the word for desert

parts.note: to rat is to desert

indicators.note: abandoning means the motorway letter is dropped

parts.note: a metre is a short distance
M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: Withdraw a little way into the wilderness, leaving the main road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desert' looks like a sandy wilderness, but here it is the verb meaning to abandon someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To retreat is to go back, to withdraw.
